    • dummy_board

      public static Board dummy_board
      Internal state of the GameState, is updated for most information requests from any GameState object. This object is shared among them and thus will not keep its state the same at most times. Please inform me (@pascal) if you intend to directly use this field for anything, as there is likely a way to solve your problem in a safer way.

    • dummy_state

      public static GameState dummy_state

    • pawn_positions

      private byte[] pawn_positions
      A byte representation of the GameState holds the positions of all pawns in an efficient format
      Every 10 elements represent the pawns of a single player in increasing order of the result from BoardNode.getID() of its board position. This representation is applicable to different board objects as the ID's are the position identifying aspect of each BoardNode.

      The length of this array is equal to Board.getPlayerCount() * 10 and the pawns per player are ordered by Board.getPlayerIndex(Player) starting at 0.

    • backupBoard

      public void backupBoard()
      This method requires dummy_board to be modified.

      Clones the dummy board at this GameState and stores it as this state's original board.
      This allows for having multiple trees side by side, but it does not allow for multi-threading over these trees. (please still iterate over each tree one at a time)
